# Getting Support 🦊

Thank you for using NoxFund! We're here to help.

## 📚 Documentation

Before asking for help, please check:

- 📖 **[Main Documentation](https://nox.fund)** - Comprehensive guides and information
- 📋 **[README](../README.md)** - Project overview and quick start
- 🔍 **[FAQ Section](https://nox.fund#faq)** - Common questions answered

## 💬 Community Support

### Telegram (Fastest Response)
Join our active community on Telegram:
- 🗨️ **[NoxFund Chat](https://t.me/noxfundchat)** - General discussion and support
- ⚡ **Average response time:** < 1 hour during business hours

### GitHub Discussions
For longer, more detailed discussions:
- 💡 **[GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/noxfund/noxfund/discussions)** - Q&A and community chat

### GitHub Issues
For bug reports or feature requests:
- 🐛 **[Report a Bug](https://github.com/noxfund/noxfund/issues/new?template=bug_report.md)**
- ✨ **[Request a Feature](https://github.com/noxfund/noxfund/issues/new?template=feature_request.md)**
- ❓ **[Ask a Question](https://github.com/noxfund/noxfund/issues/new?template=question.md)**

- **How do deposits work?** Check the [README](../README.md#-protocol-features)

## 🆘 Need Urgent Help?

### For Critical Security Issues
⚠️ **DO NOT open a public issue!**
- Email: **security@nox.fund**
- See our [Security Policy](SECURITY.md) for responsible disclosure

### For Account/Transaction Issues
1. Check your transaction on [BSCScan](https://bscscan.com)
2. Verify you're using the correct contract address
3. Contact support via Telegram with transaction hash

## 🌍 Time Zone
Primary support hours: **UTC 9:00 - 21:00** (Monday - Friday)

Community support available 24/7 via Telegram!

## ✅ Before Asking for Help

Please include:
- ✓ Clear description of your question/issue
- ✓ What you've already tried
- ✓ Transaction hash (if applicable)
- ✓ Wallet address (never share private keys!)
- ✓ Screenshots if relevant
